title: GOD WILL PERFECT
EVERY CONCERN
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step
stock_queries: wide shot of vast quiet wilderness

scenes.a: When that heavy weight of uncertainty presses upon you, remember that you are His creation.
The LORD will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.
Lord, I bring this situation before You because my own strength is failing me right now.
Guide my thoughts and steady my hands as I move forward through this difficult season ahead.
Let Your perfect will be done in the matter that keeps me awake and searching today.
In Your sovereign name, I rest in the truth that You are working behind the scenes.
